person.canonical_name_en: Hussein bin Ali, Sharif of Mecca

activity.notes: Hussein bin Ali, Sharif of Mecca, became the Hashemite monarch of the Hejaz in 1916 during the Arab Revolt. Contemporary and scholarly sources distinguish his broader 'King of the Arabs' claim from the internationally recognized kingship of the Hejaz. He abdicated in favour of his son Ali on 3 October 1924.
